{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_cleaned = sales_df.copy()
df_cleaned['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_cleaned['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the number of non-numeric values in 'revenue'
non_numeric_count = df_cleaned['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['status'] == 'completed']

# Check how many of the completed orders have NaN revenue
nan_in_completed = df_completed['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders, excluding NaN values
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the results
non_numeric_count, nan_in_completed, mean_revenue_completed"}
